Finlands Ministry of Social Affairs and Health announces 5 million EUR of discretionary funds to be granted to organisations and foundations in the health and service sector to respond to the needs for psychosocial support caused by COVID-19. Canada, a new task force was announce August 5. The COVID-19 Vaccine Task Force draws on the expertise of its vaccine and immunology experts, and industry leaders with proven experience in developing and commercializing vaccines, to provide advice to the Government of Canada on COVID-19 vaccines. The task force will be in place for at least 12 months (August 5, 2021) with a subject to extension.

On March 13, 2020, the Parliament of Japan enacted a law amendment giving Prime Minister Shinzo Abe the power to declare a state of emergency and take drastic measures in the fight against the spread of the new coronavirus. The revised law, newly covering the coronavirus, will allow the government to declare a state of emergency to authorize governors of the 47 prefectures to place restrictions on the private rights of citizens. The law will be enforced from March 14, 2020.
